# normalize

<link-summary>Resolves the `.` and `..` segments of a path.</link-summary>

<web-summary>normalize() — Resolves the `.` and `..` segments of a path. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>net/path</code></p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function normalize(path: string): string;
```

A `.` is dropped, a `..` removes the segment before it, repeated separators collapse, and a trailing separator is removed.

The result always starts at the root: `normalize("a/b")` is `"/a/b"`. Use `join` when a relative path has to stay relative.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type     | Description            |
| :-------- | :------- | :--------------------- |
| `path`    | `string` | The path to normalise. |

## Returns

`string` — the normalised path.

## Examples

### Normalising

```javascript
normalize("a/./b/../c"); // => "/a/c"
normalize("/a/b/../c/"); // => "/a/c"
```
